以下是新增段落的重點與範例：

- 清理項目：`labels.cache`、`labels.cache.npy`、`labels_cl.cache.npy`、以及任何 `*.cache*`
- 位置：`<DATASET>/{train, valid, test}/labels/`
- 安全性：刪除後訓練會自動重建快取

```cmd
REM Clear dataset caches before training (edit DATASET as needed)
set DATASET=Regurgitation-YOLODataset-Detection
for %%D in (train valid test) do (
  del /q "%DATASET%\%%D\labels\labels.cache" 2>nul
  del /q "%DATASET%\%%D\labels\labels.cache.npy" 2>nul
  del /q "%DATASET%\%%D\labels\labels_cl.cache.npy" 2>nul
  del /q "%DATASET%\%%D\labels\*.cache*" 2>nul
)
```

- 已在 `.cursorrules` 中加入「資料快取清理規則」小節與 cmd 範例。

已改為 PowerShell 語法並寫入 `.cursorrules` 的「資料快取清理規則」段落。使用前請在 PowerShell 執行。

```powershell
# Clear dataset caches before training (edit DATASET as needed)
$DATASET = "Regurgitation-YOLODataset-Detection"
$sets = @("train", "valid", "test")
foreach ($d in $sets) {
  $labels = Join-Path (Join-Path $DATASET $d) "labels"
  Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $labels "labels.cache") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
  Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $labels "labels.cache.npy") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
  Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $labels "labels_cl.cache.npy") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
  Get-ChildItem -Path $labels -Filter "*.cache*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
}
```

- 已將示例標題更新為「範例（PowerShell）」並替換整段指令
